name: single-frame-particles
title: Diagnostic: single-frame particles
summary: Deliberately flawed check: a 40-particle burst rendered as a single frame, so the particles are still clumped at the origin and render_rc / validate warn needs_frames; with duration 1 the burst spreads and the warning goes.
prompt: A particle burst rendered without duration.
teaches: Recognise needs_frames: particle and impulse documents do their per-frame work from the second frame, so render them with duration (and a seed) to see them
Emit a burst with createParticles (x, y at the centre, random vx, vy) and move it with particlesLoop equations
Start the particles at componentWidth() / 2, componentHeight() / 2 so the burst is centred in any box

snippets.note: each frame: move, damp by 0.98, add a little gravity

check.describe: render_rc with only {seed: 7} reports needs_frames and shows the particles clumped at the centre; adding duration: 1 spreads them and reports no finding. The audit's only finding is the repaint_continuous info any particle system has. Resized, the background fills the box and the burst starts from its centre (componentWidth() / 2, componentHeight() / 2).

pitfalls: A full-canvas background rectangle on its own triggers the solid warning ("only a background fill drew"), so this fixture also draws a title; without it a one-frame render would report solid as well
